title: Drops of Brandy

nodes.title: Drops of Brandy
nodes.body: A slip jig, the first dance, and better slow. Nine pulses in the bar, three groups of three. Count them that way. The airs did not have this. The listen is still the phrase.

source: Traditional slip jig. Francis O’Neill, O’Neill’s Music of Ireland (1903). Slowed setting written for this pack. The pulse is the slip jig’s, heard, not a grade.
